description: This file contains the PHP class 'Option' within the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Catalog', and implements a controller for handling CRUD and listing operations for product options in the OpenCart admin backend. It manages routes for listing options, viewing forms for editing/adding options, and processing form submissions, including pagination, sorting, and filtering logic.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: Controller class for managing product options in the OpenCart admin panel, providing methods for listing, editing, creating, and deleting options, with support for pagination, sorting, and multi-language descriptions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the options list page. Loads language, sets titles, handles sorting, pagination, and prepares data for the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a JSON response with the list of options, typically for AJAX calls to fetch data dynamically.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns an HTML view with the list of options, including sorting links, pagination, and options actions.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays a form for creating or editing a product option, pre-filling data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission to save a new or existing product option, including validation and redirects.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected options after permission check, involving validation and updating the database.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides an AJAX endpoint to fetch option data for autocomplete fields, with filtering, sorting, and image handling.
